bull.probability_evidence: Assigned the lowest probability (20%) because the bear case's deteriorating fundamentals dominate: domestic broadband revenue fell to $6.3bn from $6.6bn YoY in Q2 2026 (SEC 10-Q) and operating margin slid to 14.7% TTM from 18.8% FY24 (fact sheet income statement), leaving a clean re-rate to peer multiples the least likely path absent resolved NBCUniversal separation terms.

target_band.cite: Fact sheet Fair Value table EV/EBITDA-method implied prices bracketing the evaluator's bull basis: bear-case EV/EBITDA 27.94 and base-case EV/EBITDA 40.13 (the evaluation bull basis cites these two anchors directly); half the spread (6.095) / target (34.0) = 0.179.

base.probability_evidence: Assigned the highest probability (45%) as the central/status-quo case: RSI 23.0 and price below both the 50-day (-14.8%) and 200-day (-21.5%) moving averages show an unbroken downtrend with no catalyst before the Oct 22, 2026 earnings date (fact sheet Price section), consistent with gradual broadband erosion and margin compression continuing without resolution of separation terms.

target_band.cite: Fact sheet Valuation table: re-rating last close (20.94) fully to peer-median multiples gives disagreeing implied prices by method -- P/E (-16% vs 8.1x peer median) implies 20.94/(1-0.16)=24.93, EV/EBITDA (-36% vs 7.2x peer median) implies 20.94/(1-0.36)=32.72; half the spread (3.895) / target (24.0) = 0.162.

bear.probability_evidence: Raised to 35% (above a simple residual share) by the macro overlay's small bear tilt: the 10y Treasury yield at 5.27% (+0.72pp/3m, FRED DGS10) raises the cost of debt just as 2.43x net debt/EBITDA must be split with NBCUniversal ahead of the mid-2027 separation (research/CMCSA/2026-10-08-macro.md), layered on the already-negative broadband and margin trend (SEC 10-Q; fact sheet income statement).

target_band.cite: Fact sheet Valuation/Price sections: the evaluator's bear anchor (P/E compressing to its 5-year minimum of 5.4x from 6.8x) implies 20.94*(5.4/6.8)=16.63 versus the no-re-rate anchor at last close 20.94 (other multiples -- EV/EBITDA, P/FCF, P/B -- are already below their own 5-year minimums, so cannot serve as a further-downside anchor); half the spread (2.156) / target (16.5) = 0.131.
